barriers.description: Resource limitations prevented the ProACT platform from integrating all features required to fully support multimorbidity self-management (eg, medication management, care planning).
barriers.justification: Omitting these features constrained designers' ability to address holistic experience and to produce complete design solutions and user requirements for multimorbidity management.
barriers.reference_excerpt: First, given the resource limitations, the version of the ProACT platform described in this paper and evaluated in the trial did not integrate all of the features required to fully support the self-management of multimorbidity, with development initially focused on symptom and well-being monitoring, education, setting physical activity goals, and data sharing.

barriers.description: Project budget constraints limited triage staff and researcher availability to 9 AM–5 PM, Monday–Friday.
barriers.justification: Restricted support hours reduced the team's ability to facilitate user involvement and provide continuous evaluation/support, potentially limiting participants' engagement and the designers' capacity to gather feedback outside those hours.
barriers.reference_excerpt: The triage staff responded to alerts between 9 AM and 5 PM, Monday-Friday (hours were limited because of project budget) and made monthly check-in phone calls. Participants were made aware of the hours of triage...

barriers.description: Third-party device usability and reliability problems generated heavy technical support demand and caused some participants to withdraw from the trial.
barriers.justification: Device failures and mistrust in readings increased researchers' support workload and led to participant disengagement, which impeded the team's ability to evaluate the system with those users and to iterate based on their experiences.
barriers.reference_excerpt: Despite several reported device issues, participants felt that the platform was usable... 'It was just too hard to do because you couldn’t in the first place take the blood pressure anyway because it wasn’t working.' [P037, female, 82 years, COPD+CHD, Ireland]... Of these, 76 calls were requests for peripherals..., 121 were for devices not working..., 50 related to data syncing issues..., and 29 involved pairing or connection problems...

barriers.description: The SUS measure used did not distinguish usability between the CareApp and the symptom-monitoring devices.
barriers.justification: This measurement limitation reduced designers' ability to evaluate and specify separate user requirements or targeted improvements for the app versus the devices.
barriers.reference_excerpt: The SUS did not distinguish between the ProACT CareApp and symptom-monitoring devices. However, participant feedback suggests that the majority of usability issues lay with using the devices...

barriers.description: The proof-of-concept study design did not include a control group, preventing assessment of the effectiveness of individual platform components and services.
barriers.justification: Without a control group designers were unable to rigorously evaluate which features or services (eg, triage, technical support) were effective, limiting their ability to integrate feedback and iterate toward optimized solutions.
barriers.reference_excerpt: A further point with respect to the PoC study design ... is that a control group was not included; therefore, it was not possible to assess the effectiveness of individual components of the ProACT platform and related services (access to triage and technical support).

barriers.description: Helpdesk usage data were collected in Ireland but were not tracked in Belgium.
barriers.justification: Lack of comparable support data across countries limited the research team's ability to understand cross-site technical support needs and manage user understanding and involvement comprehensively.
barriers.reference_excerpt: To offer context to the necessity of the helpdesk, there were a total of 355 calls to the helpdesk in Ireland over the course of the trial (helpdesk calls were not tracked in Belgium).
